description: Check the processing status of a previously uploaded file. Returns the current status (PENDING_UPLOAD, UPLOADING, READY, FAILED) and whether the file is ready for download. Rarely needed — the 'transfer' tool handles polling automatically. Use this only to check on uploads that timed out or for manual status inspection.No API key required — without one you upload as a guest (100 MB, 24-hour link); a key raises the limits and lets you sell.

uploadId.description: Upload ID returned from upload_file or upload_from_url (e.g. up_a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8)

name: get_upload_status

ready.description: True when the file is fully replicated and downloadable

status.description: Current status: PENDING_UPLOAD, UPLOADING, READY, or FAILED

title: Get Upload Status
